title: Set up a team wiki
summary: Set up the team wiki with meeting notes and process templates. Notion is the canonical route.

parts.title: Create the team wiki workspace
parts.guidance: Choose the wiki's home within the company's documentation platform, checking whether a suitable workspace already exists. Set a company-controlled administrator, a clear landing page, and default access for ordinary teammates. Identify where restricted finance, personnel, or board material will live before adding content. Name a documentation owner and link the wiki from onboarding so the team has a stable starting point for company knowledge.

parts.title: Create wiki structure
parts.guidance: Organize the wiki around questions teammates repeatedly need answered: how to join, find a decision, operate a service, or run a recurring process. Keep durable instructions separate from meeting history and working drafts. Give each main area a maintainer and make the next level of navigation understandable without knowing who wrote a document. Move existing pages into the structure, repairing important links as you go and leaving a visible queue for unsorted material.

parts.title: Create meeting notes DB
parts.guidance: Create a meeting-notes collection with the meeting date, purpose, attendees, notes, and links to decisions and actions. Give each action an owner and agreed due date, and link it to the tracker when work continues there. Group recurring meetings and make past sessions searchable by date and topic. Set access according to the discussion's sensitivity, with personnel and board notes restricted. Use the next meeting to check that participants can find previous decisions and open actions.

parts.title: Create process templates
parts.guidance: Document one recurring process the team actually performs, starting with its trigger and required inputs. Describe the actions, decision points, responsible roles, and the output that means the work is finished. Turn that example into a reusable page template without forcing every process into identical sections. Include the maintainer and links to working forms or systems. Ask someone who performs the process to fill the gaps before others begin using the template.

parts.title: Share with team
parts.guidance: Check that company-wide pages are readable by ordinary teammates and that restricted sections keep their intended audience. Share the landing-page link with a short explanation of where common answers live and how to suggest changes. Ask a teammate to find an answer they currently need; use the result to improve labels or navigation. Make the maintainer visible on important pages so missing or outdated guidance reaches the person who can fix it.

metadata.supportReason: Notion API and MCP support page/database creation. Fully automatable.
